recent_news.headline: PCL-Stantec $552.4 Million South Bay Wastewater Plant Expansion 2026 in San Diego, USA
recent_news.summary: PCL Construction and Stantec are advancing a $552.4 million South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant expansion in San Diego, California, to increase the plant's average treatment capacity to 50 MGD with peak capacity of 75 MGD.

backfill_news.headline: The $43 Billion Water Boost Is Over. Now What?
backfill_news.summary: Federal water infrastructure funding from IIJA lapsed September 30, 2026, with State Revolving Funds expected to decrease 80 percent from prior year levels. Congress faces pressure to reauthorize funding as communities face a federal water infrastructure funding cliff.

backfill_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q3 2026 Earnings: Revenue Hits Record $1.87B, Adjusted EBITDA Rises 42%
backfill_news.summary: Clean Harbors reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $1.87 billion, up 21% year-over-year, with adjusted EBITDA of $456.1 million, up 42%. The Environmental Services segment achieved its 18th consecutive quarter of year-over-year margin expansion. The company raised 2026 full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.44–$1.48 billion.
